statement: The same whistle, finger hole open, sounds between 432 and 508 Hz
rationale: 470 Hz +-8 %, for the same reason as C21 (input coo-pitch-analysis). The interval the hole makes is the better-conditioned part of the model, but the open note still rides on the closed one, and a printed hole is 0.1 to 0.3 mm small: 0.1 mm of hole diameter is about 7 cents on this note.

mechanism.how: The same whistle, with the vent as it was left for C21. Hold it as it is played: the tail in the mouth up to the lip stop, the fingers forward of the window, and the whistle in the hand, not resting on a desk (a surface under the belly lowers the note by about 2 %). Lift the finger clear of the hole by at least the hole's width. Blow the same gentle, steady breath and read the note on a tuner app held at arm's length. Blow three times and take the middle reading. If it is flat, the finger hole may be reamed as TUNING.md says; record the note after that and say what was done.
